cross_gauge_rule: Operational edit IDs may differ across gauges. Structural state equivalence is established by the canonical permutation-invariant representation, not by slot-number equality.

edit_address.stale_rejection: Any mismatch in primitive, d, N, sidecar digest, gauge, slot bounds, expected status, or pre-state digest rejects.

zero_column_rule: An exact all-zero frozen column is FROZEN_ZERO and non-writable because ACTIVE versus DISABLED would otherwise create two structural encodings with identical materialized W.
